decisions.reason: The current k-j-i order makes the inner i loop access C and A with row-stride jumps; changing to i-k-j makes the inner j accesses contiguous and directly targets the extremely high load-replay and MemNotReadyStall counts without relying on undocumented thresholds.

Static evidence identifies stack-resident accumulator traffic in the 4x4 kernel. A 2x2 tile reduces accumulator register pressure and is the action most likely to keep accumulators in registers; increasing to 8x8 would aggravate spills, while replacing tiling with a scalar update discards useful reuse.
